title: This Meta Ads mistake is costing YOU results
description: This Meta Ads mistake is costing YOU results
transcript: Quick meta ads tip, set up your audience segments within your meta ad account, that way you can see where meta is spending your budget and where your results are coming from. So your audiences should be split into three different categories. You've got new audience, people who have never engaged with your business before. You've got engaged audience, people who have engaged with your business but not yet bought. This could be people who have visited your website, people on your email list, people who've engaged with you on Facebook or Instagram and then you've got existing customers, people who have bought from you previously. Once you've got those audience segments set up, you can then look at breakdown in your reporting and have a look at where is my money being spent and where am I getting results from. A lot of interesting things come from that analysis. You might realise that a lot of your ad budget is actually being spent on existing customers and you might want to make some adjustments to make sure you reach a broader audience.
